items.title: Jimmy Lewis interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: We had Wardell Gray, Clark Terry, Gus Johnson on drums, Freddie Green on guitar, me on bass

ctx.x: Is this when Basie had the small group?
Yes, the small group. We had Wardell Gray, Clark Terry, Gus Johnson on drums, Freddie Green on guitar, me on bass and like we used Bud DeFranco playing tenor.
Can I read something that Joe Williams said about that group?

items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: It was me, Clark Terry, Jimmy Lewis, Buddy DeFranco, Bob Garth.

ctx.x: Oh, yes, Freddie was out of the band. I said, 'Where's Freddie Green?' He said, 'Well, I got this job in Chicago and I booked just for a small band, six pieces.' I said, 'Man, you better get Freddie Green back in this band,' just like that. And we made the job in Chicago, at the Brass Rail. And Freddie wasn't with us. It was me, Clark Terry, Jimmy Lewis, Buddy DeFranco, Bob Garth.] He's a tenor player.
